The figure also draws the center O2 of the particle's circular motion on the right side of point E, and EO2 is the direction of the orbital radius. Reasoning: Take O1 as the origin, ab as the y-axis, and rightward as the x-axis. The distance from the incident point E to ab is R/2, and E is on the lower right of the circumference, so the coordinates of E are E=(R/2, -√3R/2). The particle is positively charged, the magnetic field is perpendicular to the plane of the paper outward, and the incident velocity is upward. From the direction of the Lorentz force, it can be known that the particle deflects to the right, so the center of the orbit O2 is on the right side of E. Let the radius of the particle's circular motion in the magnetic field be r, then r=mv/(qB), and O2=(R/2+r, -√3R/2). The angle between the velocity direction when the particle exits the magnetic field and when it enters the magnetic field is 60°. In circular motion, the angle through which the velocity direction turns is equal to the central angle through which the radius direction turns, so the central angle of the orbit from E to M is 60°. At incidence, the radius direction from O2 to E is horizontally leftward. After turning through 60°, the coordinate increment of M relative to O2 is (-r/2, √3r/2). Therefore M=(R/2+r-r/2, -√3R/2+√3r/2)=(R/2+r/2, √3(r-R)/2). M is on the boundary of the large circle, satisfying x_M^2+y_M^2=R^2: [(R+r)/2]^2+[√3(r-R)/2]^2=R^2. raw_record.question_text: As shown in the figure, the circle with radius R is the cross section (the plane of the paper) of a cylindrical uniform magnetic-field region, the magnitude of the magnetic induction intensity is B, and the direction is perpendicular to the plane of the paper outward. A particle with charge q（q>0） and mass m enters the magnetic-field region in a direction parallel to the diameter ab, and the distance between the entry point and ab is $\frac{R}{2}$. method.method_draft: 先读图：圆形磁场区域中心为 O1，竖直虚线为直径 ab；粒子从右下方边界点 E 射入，速度方向竖直向上，与 ab 平行，轨迹在磁场内向右弯曲后从右侧点 M 射出；图中还暗示粒子圆周运动的圆心 O2 在 E 的右侧，EO2 为入射点处轨道半径。读题：大圆半径为 R，入射点到直径 ab 的水平距离为 R/2，出射速度方向相对入射速度偏转 60°，q>0，B 垂直纸面向外。建立坐标：令 O1 为原点，ab 为 y 轴，则由图选取右下入射点 E=(R/2, -√3R/2)。粒子在匀强磁场中做半径 r=mv/(qB) 的圆周运动；因速度方向改变 60°，轨道半径方向也转过 60°。入射时轨道圆心 O2 在 E 右方，所以 O2=(R/2+r, -√3R/2)。出射点 M 相对 O2 的半径方向由水平向左转到与其夹 60°，可写 M=(R/2+r/2, -√3R/2+√3r/2)。利用 M 仍在磁场边界大圆上，代入 x_M^2+y_M^2=R^2，得 r=R。最后由 r=mv/(qB) 得 v=qBR/m。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中圆形区域表示匀强磁场横截面，圆心标为 O1，竖直虚线是直径 ab，磁场用圆点表示方向垂直纸面向外。粒子从右下方圆周上的 E 点射入，速度方向竖直向上，与 ab 平行；轨迹在磁场内向右弯曲，从右侧边界 M 点射出。图中还画出粒子圆周运动的圆心 O2 在 E 点右侧，EO2 为轨道半径方向。

推理：以 O1 为原点，ab 为 y 轴，向右为 x 轴。入射点 E 到 ab 的距离为 R/2，且 E 在圆周右下方，所以 E 的坐标为 E=(R/2, -√3R/2)。粒子带正电，磁场垂直纸面向外，入射速度向上，由洛伦兹力方向可知粒子向右偏转，因此轨道圆心 O2 在 E 的右侧。设粒子在磁场中的圆周运动半径为 r，则 r=mv/(qB)，且 O2=(R/2+r, -√3R/2)。

粒子射出磁场与射入磁场时速度方向夹角为 60°，圆周运动中速度方向转过的角度等于半径方向转过的圆心角，因此从 E 到 M 的轨道圆心角为 60°。入射时从 O2 指向 E 的半径方向为水平向左，转过 60° 后，M 相对 O2 的坐标增量为 (-r/2, √3r/2)。所以 M=(R/2+r-r/2, -√3R/2+√3r/2)=(R/2+r/2, √3(r-R)/2)。

M 在大圆边界上，满足 x_M^2+y_M^2=R^2：
[(R+r)/2]^2+[√3(r-R)/2]^2=R^2。
化简得 (R+r)^2+3(r-R)^2=4R^2，即 4r^2-4Rr=0。由于 r>0，故 r=R。

由 r=mv/(qB)=R，得 v=qBR/m。
